output.reason: A 68-year-old with COPD reporting two days of worsening breathlessness now provoked by walking to the bathroom, with green phlegm, needs same-day hands-on assessment including oxygen saturation, lung exam and chest imaging, which messaging cannot provide.
output.patientMessage: Please be seen in person today — an urgent care or ED visit — for an oxygen-level check, lung exam and chest X-ray, because your breathing has worsened over two days and you're now winded walking to the bathroom with green phlegm. Call 911 right away if you become breathless at rest, can't speak full sentences, turn blue, or feel confused or drowsy. A Counsel clinician can follow up in this thread.
